scope: Substantive refresh of an existing post at its URL, adding sources

observations.summary: Soft 0 to 60 mg/L, moderately hard 61 to 120, hard 121 to 180, very hard over 180, as calcium carbonate; calcium and magnesium are the main constituents; linked to scaling in equipment and more soap and detergent use; constituents are not toxic.

District water is hard to very hard; 2017 ranges about 150 to 370 ppm Capitola and Soquel, 140 to 300 Soquel and Aptos, 150 to 200 Aptos and Rio del Mar, 100 to 200 La Selva Beach; 1 gpg equals 17.1 mg/L; hard water is not a health hazard; EPA recommends softeners certified by NSF, UL or WQA.
observations.inference_limit: One local water district; other providers differ. Data year 2017 as published.

observations.summary: County ordinance bars softener and drinking water filter discharge to septic; County Environmental Health handout warns brine harms tank bacteria and clogs the leach field. Same sources already cited by the merged water filtration post.
